propositions: Cloning repo with --filter=blob:none reduces size from 1.04 GiB to 68.7 MiB and time from 59s to 14.3s; --filter=tree:0 must not be used as it produces 3.57 GiB
derive_caused_by calls git blame on every bug close without explicit --caused-by, which fails under blobless promisor by faulting blobs one at a time
_blame_file_commits currently returns [] both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure undetectable and requiring refactor to return None on failure and [] on empty
Partial blame failure across multiple paths causes derive_caused_by to tally over incomplete set and elect wrong culprit, persisting incorrect caused_by link
derive_caused_by must abort derivation and return None if any per-path blame fails, while still permitting legitimately empty files to succeed
